Description:
dotnet-inspect 0.20.0+d0b60e8 - A CLI tool for inspecting .NET libraries and NuGet packages

Usage:
dotnet-inspect [command] [options]

Options:
-v <v>                         Verbosity: q(uiet), m(inimal), n(ormal), d(etailed)
-T, --tips <tips>              Tip verbosity: q(uiet), m(inimal), d(etailed)
--offline                      Disable all network access (use cached data only)
--trace-mermaid                Write a Mermaid request trace diagram to stderr at process exit
--http-timeout <http-timeout>  Seconds to wait for a network request before giving up (1-3600, default 30)
-?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information
--version                      Show version information

Commands:
type <args>        Discover types in a package or library (compact table output)
member <args>      Inspect type members (docs on by default)
library <source>   Inspect a .NET library file
cache              Manage the dotnet-inspect cache
diff <args>        Compare API surfaces, analysis signals, or implementation evidence between versions
timeline <args>    Correlate API or member-body Findings across a package version range
depends <type>     Walk dependency graphs upward (type hierarchy, library references, or package dependencies)
extensions <type>  Find extension methods for a type
find <pattern>     Search for types across packages and libraries
body-shape <kind>  Search one library for an exact stable rendered body-syntax kind
implements <type>  Find types implementing an interface or extending a base class
package <package>  Inspect a NuGet package
project <path>     Inspect restored project package references
skill              Show skill definition (router to focused skills)

Description:
Discover types in a package or library (compact table output)

Usage:
dotnet-inspect type [<args>...] [options]

Arguments:
<args>  Package and type pattern. When no --package/--library/--platform is given, first arg is the package.

Options:
--package <package>                Source: package (file, name, name@version, or name@A..B)
--at <at>                          Address in a package range: exact version, #N, first, or last
--library <library>                Source: library path (local file, or relative within package)
--platform <platform>              Source: platform library (e.g., System.Text.Json)
--project <project>                Source: restored project.assets.json context
--framework <framework>            Source: platform framework (runtime, aspnetcore, netstandard). @version for specific
--tfm <tfm>                        Source: select by TFM (e.g., net8.0)
--all                              Include non-public, hidden, and obsolete members
-t, --type <t>                     Filter types by glob pattern (e.g., *Json*, Progress*)
--json                             Output as JSON
--compact                          Output as minified JSON (use with --json)
--raw                              Emit GitHub URLs as raw/fetchable URLs (default; URL-shape modifier, not an output-shape modifier)
--blob                             Emit GitHub URLs as browser-friendly /blob/ URLs (URL-shape modifier, not an output-shape modifier)
--table                            Output as a pretty table (space-padded columns)
--tsv                              Output as normalized tab-separated values
--jsonl                            Output as JSON Lines (one object per row)
--nh, --no-header, --no-headers    Suppress table/TSV column headers
--shape                            Output type shape (inheritance, interfaces, members)
--unsafe                           Filter types with unsafe signatures (pointers)
-m, --member <m>                   Filter members by name or limit count (-m 5)
-k, --kind <k>         
[truncated]

Description:
Inspect a .NET library file

Usage:
dotnet-inspect library [<source>] [options]

Arguments:
<source>  Library file path, NuGet package name (e.g., System.Text.Json), or package@version

Options:
--references                             Legacy alias for -S References
--dependencies                           Legacy alias for -S References --tree
--depth <depth>                          With -S References --tree: maximum depth (1 = direct references only)
--platform <platform>                    Inspect platform library (e.g., System.Text.Json)
--package <package>                      Inspect library from NuGet package (e.g., System.Text.Json or System.Text.Json@9.0.4)
--preview, --prerelease                  When resolving an unversioned package, include prerelease versions
--framework <framework>                  Optional platform framework family (runtime, aspnetcore)
--version <version>                      Platform runtime version (searches framework families in priority order)
--tfm <tfm>                              Select a package library by TFM (e.g., net8.0; 'all' supports Markdown, JSON, and aggregate --count)
-t, --type <t>                           Filter Source Files rows by type glob/name (e.g., *Json*)
--il-offset <il-offset>                  MethodDef token + IL offset for coordinate-scoped sections (e.g., 0x06000001+0x5)
--il-offsets <il-offsets>                Text file of sparse MethodDef token + IL offset coordinates to explain
--heap <heap>                            Metadata heap coordinate for the coordinate-scoped heap section (e.g., #Strings:0x1a4)
--raw                                    Emit GitHub URLs as raw/fetchable URLs (default; URL-shape modifier, not an output-shape modifier)
--blob                                   Emit GitHub URLs as browser-friendly /blob/ URLs (URL-shape modifier, not an output-shape modifier)
--extract-resources <extract-resources>  Extract embedded resources beneath a directory without overwriting files
--trace

Description:
Compare API surfaces, analysis signals, or implementation evidence between versions

Usage:
dotnet-inspect diff [<args>...] [options]

Arguments:
<args>  Version range and type filter. When no --package/--platform/--library is given, first arg is the package version range.

Options:
--package <package>              Package with version range (e.g., System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.2)
--platform <platform>            Platform library with version range (e.g., System.Text.Json@8.0.23..10.0.2)
--library <library>              Local library path range (e.g., old/Foo.dll..new/Foo.dll)
--framework <framework>          Framework for platform diff (runtime, aspnetcore). Default: runtime
--tfm <tfm>                      Target framework (e.g., net8.0)
--all                            Include non-public, hidden, and obsolete members
-t, --type <t>                   Filter to specific type(s)
-m, --member <m>                 Filter to specific member selector(s); use with --type or pass Type.Member
--table                          Output as a pretty table (space-padded columns)
--tsv                            Output as normalized tab-separated values
--jsonl                          Output as JSON Lines (one object per row)
--nh, --no-header, --no-headers  Suppress table/TSV column headers
--json                           Output as JSON
--markdown                       Output as markdown
--name-only                      Show only type names that changed
--breaking                       Show only breaking changes
--additive                       Show only additive changes
--changed                        Analysis Diff only: show only in-place changes to members present in both versions (drop added/removed members)
--alloc-regressions              Analysis Diff focus: show only allocation increases on members present in both versions (the file-able set), in-loop (hot) ones first
--authored-source                Implementation Diff only: acquire checksum-verified authored SourceLink evidence
--repo <repo>            
[truncated]

Description:
Show skill definition (router to focused skills)

Usage:
dotnet-inspect skill [command] [options]

Options:
-n <n>  Count of output lines to keep (like head -n); pair with --tail to take them from the end

Commands:
list           List available focused skills
query          Output formats, curated package/library -D/-S discovery and selection, value projection, @ categories, and output limits shared across commands.
private-feeds  Inspect packages from private and custom NuGet feeds safely — select and map sources, use credential providers or explicit configuration, diagnose authentication failures, and reason about source-bound caches and offline operation.
compatibility  Decide whether a change or upgrade is safe — API-surface diffs, behavioral diffs (allocations, exceptions), feature switches, and version resolution.
correctness    Judge whether code is sound and safe to call — its exception surface (throws, catches, exception types) and the unsafe operations in a method body.
signals        Surface a dependency's observable signals — provenance, compatibility, dependency risk, unsafe/PInvoke surface, artifact-text containment, and identifier confusion — to judge how much caution it warrants. Observations, not verdicts.
sourcelink     Find SourceLink-mapped original source through PDB data — map files and member locations, fetch source, or resolve checksum-matched content locally.
metadata       Query raw ECMA-335 assembly metadata — discover table and heap sections, inspect decoded rows and handles, address table or heap coordinates, and project bounded machine-readable results.
decompiler     Reconstruct a method or type as C# and IL — decompiled source, annotated source with hidden facts, raw IL, fidelity levels, and IL-offset lookup. Use --offline to prohibit package and PDB network acquisition.
deep-inspect   Run and interpret opt-in expensive validation lanes: full slow tests, IL round-trip sweep, corpus sensors, package discovery, validity scans, and analysis census.
performance    Whole-a
